segment_name: Putnam Trail paving

evidence: NYC paved the Putnam Trail in Van Cortlandt Park in August 2020.

segment_name: First segment
source_title: South County Trailway - Wikipedia
evidence: County built trail in segments starting 1990; first segment opened August 1999.
notes: Wikipedia only; segment endpoints not given in source. No county source found for 1999.

segment_name: Final section (Elmsford gap)
source_title: Astorino opens final section of South County Trailway
evidence: Astorino opened last segment Oct 31 2017; with North County Trailway spans 37 miles NYC line to Putnam line.
notes: Funded by $2.75M bond (2016) plus NYSDOT lease along Saw Mill River. Trailway is ~14.1 mi total.

segment_name: Reconstruction Barney St (Yonkers) to Route 119 (Elmsford)

evidence: $3.1M reconstruction of 6.4-mile portion; trailway reopened/fully paved June 2022.

evidence: County timeline: longer-term lease in 1984; next phase Eastview to south of Rt 117 completed same year.

segment_name: Mount Pleasant 'missing link' (completion)

evidence: Half-mile missing link in Mount Pleasant finished in 2002, completing ~22-mile trailway Eastview to Baldwin Place.

evidence: Bridge over East Branch Croton River reopened Nov 7 2025, completing final missing link of 9-mile Brewster-Dutchess line segment.
